subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should outputSchema become the supported optional third-party plugin API for AgentToolResult.details once transcript projection is made validation-safe?
rationale: This deliberately expands the public Plugin SDK and defines validation/error semantics for third-party tools; repository policy requires maintainer intent rather than inferring permanent API direction from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve after ordering fix
options.body: Accept outputSchema as the public contract after validation is moved ahead of transcript projection and focused compatibility coverage passes.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Limit result schemas to trusted built-in tooling until the third-party schema subset and upgrade contract are designed separately.

options.title: Decline the contract
options.body: Retain unknown/raw-first results and avoid adding another permanent Plugin SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after ordering fix
recommendation.body: Accept outputSchema as the public contract after validation is moved ahead of transcript projection and focused compatibility coverage passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged Code Mode sequence and are assigned to the API proposal, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
